text:
jamie: quick sync 1: we need to stop leaking long-lived KMS blobs during hosted->dedicated fallbacks. thoughts on a minimal handshake?
nora: +1. propose opaque short TTL session token + a tiny signed capability manifest. runtime gets no raw secrets.
felix: agree. token claims: sub, aud:adapter, exp, cap_hash, orig_handshake_id. TTL 15s. no kms:decrypt.
jamie: fallback policy depends on tier: free -> 503; standard -> failover region; enterprise -> cached read-only if manifest allows (cached_stale_after). must emit audit metric when cached creds used.
nora: manifest example (compact): scope:serve;allow_rebind:0;models:redwood-v1;cached_stale_after:120;audited:1. sign it.
felix: runtime obligations: accept session_token + signed_manifest + orig_handshake_id, validate signature, reject any handshake with raw_secret/kms_blob.
security-bot: security checklist updated: mint service must not grant kms:Decrypt; IAM policy enforced.
jamie: next steps: felix prototype mint + integration test (ETA Tue), nora draft RFC for manifest & fallbacks (ETA Thu).
nora: also add alert rule on handshake_cached_cred_used rate.
felix: noted. will also include orig_handshake_id in traces.
jamie: keep the handshake surface minimal. thanks.
